newsitem.title: USA: Loral, China to sign satellite deal - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Loral, China to sign satellite deal - WSJ.

text.p: Loral Space & Communications Ltd is close to signing a deal with China to distribute telephone service for its Globalstar Telecommunications Ltd satellite network, the Wall Street Journal reported on Monday.
The newspaper cited "people familiar with the pact" as saying the company could announce an agreement with the Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications by as early as Monday.

The deal would have the ministry's China Telecommunications Broadcast Satellite Corp (Chinasat) build and operate four ground stations to distribute telephone service for the planned $2.5 billion Globalstar network, it said.
Globalstar would serve about 200,000 subscribers or about eight percent of the total subscriber base projected for the beginning of the next century, it said.
Chinasat would begin building the first station in Beijing by the end of the year before going on to build the others in Lanzhou, Shanghai and Guangzhou, it added.
The newspaper said the stations would link the network's 48 operating satellites to the country's land lines and wireless telephone networks.
